mapper.select: SELECT FP.*, FP.CCY,NVL(FPA.FACE_VALUE,100) AS faceValue, FPT.TYPE_11 type11, FPT.TYPE_12 type12 FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID AND FPT.BRANCH=0 WHERE FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
